decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (see attached schedule) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. The phasing of development shall be in accordance with drawing number A2032 P73 C1 Phasing Diagram P1GWQ Masterplan updated 31st March 2009.

Condition : 3 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority then the approval may only be taken as having been given if it is given expressly by reference to the relevant condition (and for the avoidance of doubt agreement expressed under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 shall not, alone, be taken as such an approval) and the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by the local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Within the total 9,448sqm (GEA) non-residential floor space (maximum) hereby permitted, with reference to the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005, there shall be: (a) 5,277sqm (GEA) of CI use floor space in Building 1; (b) 201sqm (GEA) flexible A1/A2/A3/A4 floor space and 432 A1/A2/A3/A4 floorspace in Building 3 and no units shall be amalgamated or consolidated to create a unit in excess of 500sqm GEA; (c) 231sqm (GEA) flexible A1/A2/A3/A4 floor space in Building 12; (d) 816sqm (GEA) Dl floor space in Building 5, plus an additional 350sqm for a period of no more than 3 academic years (i.e. until 31st August 2018) located within Unit 3; (e) 197sqm (GEA) Dl floor space in Building 9; (f) 320sqm (GEA) A2/B1/Dl floor space in Building 10; (g) 134sqm (GEA) Al floor space in Building 5; (h) 137sqm (GEA) B1 floor space in Building 6; (i) 324sqm (GEA) B1 floor space in Building 7; (j) 143sqm (GEA) flexible A2/B1 floor space in Building 9; and (k) 311sqm (GEA) flexible A1/A2/A3/B1 floor space in Building 7; and, notwithstanding the provisions of Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005; (l) any change of use of the flexible A3/A4 floor space in Buildings 3 and 12 shall require the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority; (m) the D1 floor space in Building 5 shall be used as a nursery/cr?che and for no other purpose falling within Class D1, except the additional 350sqm located within Unit 3 which shall be used as a primary school for a period of no more than 3 academic years (i.e. until 31st August 2018); (o) any change of use from B1 use (for the avoidance of doubt, where no more than 235sqm) shall require the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority; and (p) the flexible A2/B1 floor space in Building 9 shall be used as an estate management office/film liaison office and f

Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Other than as approved by drawings numbers: XAG12 SM 014A1997 F 2109 C10A1997 J 2105 P5A1997 L 2103 P5A1995 Q 2108 P4A 1677 1770 P14QF 5963 GA 027420300-M-20150 Rev C27420300-M-20181 Rev C27420300-M-20211 Rev C27420300-M-20161 Rev C2XAG12-SM-001 Rev AXAG12-SM-003 Rev AXAG12- SM-007 Rev DXAG12-SM-008 Rev EXAG12-SM-022 Rev CXAG12-SM-023 Rev C received 29/4/09 and the details relating to Buildings 2, 3, 6, 7, 9 and 10 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(6i,7a-ci) dated 24/10/2014, and the details relating to Building 12 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(B12)(6-7) dated 15/05/2014, and the details relating to Building 5 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(B5)(6-7) dated 05/06/2014, no fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Applications relating to the ventilation of the DI floor space shall be accompanied by details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected and the approved details fully implemented and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 7 - (a) Before any plant and/or machinery is used, it shall be enclosed with sound insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme that shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
(b) The approved scheme of sound insulation as shown on drawings XAG12 SM 014A1997 F 2109 C10A1997 J 2105 PSA1997 L 2103 P5A1995 Q 2108 P4A 16771770 P14QF 5963 GA 027420300-M-20150 Rev C27420300-M-20181 Rev C27420300-M-20211 Rev C27420300-M-20161 Rev C2XAG12-SM-001 Rev AXAG12-SM-003 Rev AXAG12-SM- 007 Rev DXAG12-SM-008 Rev EXAG12-SM-022 Rev CXAG12-SM-023 Rev C Received 29/4/09, shall be carried out as approved and no residential unit shall be occupied until the approved scheme of sound insulation for the relevant phase has been carried out.
(c) The parts of the development for which A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, C1 and D1 uses have been permitted shall not be first used until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details relating to Buildings 2, 3, 6, 7, 9 and 10 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(6i,7a-ci) dated 24/10/2014, and the details relating to Building 12 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(B12)(6-7) dated 15/05/2014, and the details relating to Building 5 approved with reference 00505/P/P102(B5)(6-7) dated 05/06/2014.

Condition : 8 - The uses hereby permitted for Shops (A1 Use Class) shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 7am to 11pm on weekdays (Monday-Friday) and Saturdays, and 11am to 11pm on Sundays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11:00pm every day.

Condition : 9 - The parts of the development hereby permitted for Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or for Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9am to 11pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and on Saturdays, and 11am to 11pm on Sundays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11pm every day.

Condition : 10 - The uses hereby permitted for Financial and Professional Services (A2 Use Class) shall not be carried on outside the following times: 8am to 6pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8am to 6pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - No amplified or other music shall be played in any premises hereby permitted for use either as Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) outside the following times: 11am to 11pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays), Saturdays and Sundays.

Condition : 12 - The parts of the development hereby permitted for Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or for Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall be fitted with self-closing external doors unless otherwise approved, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority. No outside areas shall be used for A3 or A4 uses without the express approval, in advance and in writing, of the Local Planning Authority (for the avoidance of doubt, there shall be no alterations, additions or improvement to the surface of the land or construction of any physical barrier without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority).

Condition : 13 - No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 22.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 14 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8.30am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - (a) External illumination of the site during construction operations shall comply with the Institute of Lighting Engineers, Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light. (b) Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and/or chassis of any vehicles leaving the site during construction operations shall be undertaken and shall include: (i) an automatic wheel-washing system; (ii) dampening down during crushing of any demolished material for re-use on site; and (iii) the covering of all loads of construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter on vehicles exiting the site. (c) Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by construction operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried onto the adjoining properties shall be undertaken in accordance with 'The control of dust and emissions from construction and demolition Best Practice Guidance' at http://www. london.gov.uk/m ay or/environment/ air_quality/docs/constructiondustbpg.pdf (d) No construction vehicles shall access the site from/egress onto the Great West Road between the hours of 7am to 10am and 4pm to 7pm. (e) Measures to protect the residential units from noise shall be undertaken and shall conform to BS5228 (1992/1997)? Code of Practice for the Control of Noise on Construction and Open Sites.

Condition : 16 - The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall be carried out in accordance with the 'Waste and Recycling Strategy Site-Wide' document hereby permitted unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 17 - Before any premises hereby permitted for use as either Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) opens to customers a scheme for the control of fumes and odours from the relevant premises, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing, and the scheme fully implemented in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 18 - Hard and soft landscaping of the site shall be in accordance with the approved details as shown by Amended Plan 01715.L.320 and email from agent received 21/9/09.Fabrik 01715 L 100 Rev A, Fabrik 01715 L 200 Rev A, Fabrik 01715 L 201 Rev A, Fabrik 01715 L 202 Rev 0, Fabrik 01715 L 300 Rev A, Fabrik 01715 L 301 Rev A, Fabrik 01715 L 302 Rev 0, Fabrik 01715 L 710 Rev 0, Fabrik Play Strategy, Fabrik 01715 Landscape Management Plan Rev A, Assael A 16771124 F10 pavilions, Assael A 1994 Z 1111 P3 'Extent of Podium Deck', HBS 3838 Luminarie Schedule B 050309HBS 3838 WE 1000 Rev HHBS 3838 Z E 1063 C1 HBS 3838 Z E 1065 P1HBS 3838ZE1068 P2HBS 3838ZE1070 P1HBS 3838ZE1071P1HBS3838ZE1073 C1HBS GWO Rainwater Harvesting Strategy documentHBS Drawing 3838 Z M 2049 P1 HBS Drawing 3838 Z M 2017 2 C1SW03 0505 956 P1SW Proposed Surface Water Strategy Overview SW 03-0505 950 T1SW 03-0505 951T1SW03-0505 952 P1 Received 29/4/09.

Condition : 19 - The landscape areas shall be managed and maintained in accordance with the approved Landscape Management Plan o Fabrik 01715 Landscape Management Plan Rev A received 29/4/09 for a minimum of five years. The approved landscape management plan included long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas (other than small, privately owned, domestic gardens) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 20 - Before the occupation of Building B, details of: (a) the vehicle access points from Ealing Road, Clayponds Lane and the service road parallel to the Great West Road; (b) sightlines at points of access to the public highway; and (c) the kerb line alteration of the egress onto the Great West Road shall have been (i) submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and (ii) the approved works carried out.

Condition : 21 - Details of car parking (including motor cycle parking) and covered and secure cycle parking provision for buildings 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 as shown on approved drawing numbers: A2032-PC80?01-P1, A2032-PC80-02-P1, A 1944?Z?2162-C9, A 1944?Z?2194-C2, A 1944?Z?2195-C10, A 1944-Z-2196? C4, A 1944?Z?3150-C2, A 1944?Z?6609-C6, A 1944-Z-661 O-P2, A 1944-Z-6705-P2, A 1944-6753-C8, A 1944?Z?6754-P3, A 1944?Z?6755-P3, 3838/SD/E/1 OOO-P1 , 3838/Z/E/1006-C2, 3838Z/E/1007 -C2, 3838/Z/E/1008-C2, 3838/Z/E/1019-C2, 3838/Z/E/1020-C2, 3838/Z/E/1021-C2, XAG12-SM-001 ?AB, XAG12-SM-002-AB, XAG12-SM-003AB, XAG12-SM? 004B, XAG12?SM?009E, XAG12-SM-010E, XAG12-EL-003H, 0200-SK-85-A Received: 25 April 2012 and A1944 Z 101 P12A1944Z102 P12, A1944 Z 103 P12 Received 24/7/12 which included details of means of access thereto; widths development hereby permitted and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose than as approved.(ii) The cycle parking spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose. The details submitted should be set out in accordance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 22 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved with reference 00505/P/P102(22) dated 09/04/2014. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained in full working order thereafter. (i) No more than the approved number of car parking spaces shall be provided on or under the site for the development hereby permitted and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose than as approved. (ii) The cycle parking spaces shall be, permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose. The details submitted should be set out in accordance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 23 - (a) The 68 wheelchair units listed in the 'Schedule of Wheelchair Units' referenced A2032 7100 P3 shall be fitted out in accordance with approved plans: Amended plans A2032 SK 0409 10 P2, SK 0409 11 P2, SK 0409 12 P2, SK 0409 13 P2, SK 0409 14 P2, SK 0409 15 P2, SK 0409 16 P2, SK 0409 17 P2, SK 040918 P2, SK 0409 19 P2, SK 0409 20 P2, SK 0409 21 P2, SK 0409 22 P2, SK 0409 23 P2, SK 0409 24 P2 received 16/6/09, SK 0409 25SK 0409 25aSK 0409 26SK 0409 26aSK 0409 27SK 0409 28SK 0409 29SK 0409 30SK 0409 31SK 0409 32SK 0409 33SK 0409 34 received 29/4/09 b) All of the 676 residential units hereby approved shall comply with Joseph Rowntree Foundation Lifetime Homes 2006 Standards.

Condition : 24 - The parts of the development for which non-residential uses have been permitted and all other doorways used by the public shall have access doorways with a minimum clear width of 900mm and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground or floor level as relevant.

Condition : 25 - The details of the standing space(s) and bus stop(s) off the central 'piazza' shall be implemented as shown on approved drawings: Covering Letter received 2/2/11, D1715.L.200J, D1715.L.430A, 01715 L 201 K, 01715 L 202 rev F, 0220/SK/72A, 0220/SK/730, 0220/SK/74A Received 2/2/11, Email TfL to LBH -1/10/10, Email Barratt Homes to TFL -16/4/10Email WSP to TFL o 5/8/10, Email Hoare Lea to TFL o 18/4/10, Email Barratt Homes to TFL o 6/4/10 Received 2/2/10, Hoare Lea Lighting Strategy, Report Marshall Product data Sheet, WSP Letter dated the 29/1/10 Received 9/2/10. The stands shall be constructed in accordance with the approved plans.
Condition : 26 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground or within 10 metres of the boundary of the operational railway.

Condition : 27 - Any scaffold that is to be constructed adjacent to the railway shall be erected in such a manner that at no time will any poles or cranes over-sail or fall onto the railway. All plant and scaffolding must be positioned such that in the event of failure it will not fall onto Network Rail land.

Condition : 28 - (a) Techniques to address privacy and blank wall issues shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans (elevations and floor plans) and Sections 3.0 and 4.0 of the Supplementary Design & Access Statement and no building shall be occupied until all of the techniques proposed for it have been implemented. The approved techniques shall be retained and maintained thereafter (for the avoidance of doubt, shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than as approved). (b) No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the buildings hereby approved without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 29 - The approved scheme, as depicted by Amended Plan A2032 SK 0609 01 P3 Images 1,2,3 Bollards Received 21/7/09, demonstrating how a 20mph on site speed restriction for all vehicles used in association with the approved development, shall be implemented and maintained as approved.

Condition : 30 - Before any premises hereby permitted for use as Retail (A1 Use Class), Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) opens to customers, the detailed design of the shop front for that premises shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development carried out in accordance with the approved details. The details approved relating to Buildings 2, 3, 6, 7, 9 and 10 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(29i,31i) dated 15/09/2014. The details approved relating to Building 12 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(B12)(29,31) dated 09/04/2014. The details approved relating to Building 5 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(B5)(29,31) dated 05/06/2014. The details approved relating to Buildings 6, 7, 9 and 10 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(29ii).

Condition : 31 - The premises hereby permitted for use as Retail (A1 Use Class), Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises and shall not extend to the delivery of food and/or drink to customers by vehicle unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 32 - The non-residential parts of the development shall not be first used until details of measures to prevent light spill from the illumination of the interior of the non-residential floor space, including a timetable for implementation, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details. The details approved relating to Buildings 2, 3, 6, 7, 9 and 10 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(29i,31i) dated 15/09/2014. The details approved relating to Building 12 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(B12)(29,31) dated 09/04/2014. The details approved relating to Building 5 shall be implemented in accordance with approval reference 00505/P/P102(B5)(29,31) dated 05/06/2014.

Condition : 33 - No internal fit out of the apart-hotel suites shall take place on Building 1 (the 25-storey tower) until details indicating the provision of fully wheelchair accessible apart-hotel details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details as approved shall be implemented prior to occupation of the building and retained and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 34 - Approved plans A1994 L 2100 P12A1994 L 2101A1994 L 2102A1994 L 2103A1994 N 2100A1994 N 2101A1994 N 2102A1994 N 2103A2032 7000 P4A2032 7100 P4 Received 29/4/09 of Buildings 14 and 16 showing 65 residential units in Building 14 (comprising 34 one bedroom units, 26 two-bedroom units and 5 three-bedroom units) and 46 residential units in Building 16 (comprising 10 one-bedroom units, 35 two-bedroom units and 1 three-bedroom unit) and a total of 32 wheelchair adaptable units shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
Condition : 35 - The mix of the 678 residential units hereby permitted shall be: Studio flats: 4 One bedroom flats: 280 Two-bedroom flats: 334 Three-bedroom flats: 59 Four bedroom flats:1

Condition : 36 - Within 3 months of occupation of Unit 3, Building 5, an updated School Travel Plan shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures and recommendations of the Travel Plan shall be implemented throughout the occupation of Unit 3, Building 5 by the Floreat Primary School.
